name: Hello (process example)
description: A tiny process plugin: one RPC, one RPC-backed slash command, a run.finished hook and a setting. Python 3, standard library only.

rpc.name: echoPrompt
rpc.description: Returns {prompt} built from the greeting setting and the command's text.

rpc.name: helloView
rpc.description: Returns the ui:1 document of the Hello task panel.

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Insert a greeting prompt (answered by the plugin process)
